0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The concerned townsdwarf is wrestling with her worries.

48.original: I hope she'll be all right...

49.original: Oh, lali-ho! Sorry, I was off in my own little world there...

50.original: I just can't shake the sight of it─my best friend, meeting in secret with one of them filthy, no-good Goggs. If the others were to hear about this, her honor would be forfeit!

51.original: So can you believe I saw her heading out into Scree─alone─not a few moments ago? At least she had the decency to hang her head in shame. Please, stranger, I need you to convince her to stop this madness while I keep the chief's attention elsewhere.

52.original: ...Come back to the village? No, I bloody well will not! I need to be alone. Have you never felt the pain of heartbreak!?

53.original: Argh! I m-mean... Just go away!

54.original: ...Bah, I might as well tell you now, eh? I was in love with a Gogg.

55.original: It all began the day a cliffkite attacked me as I was coming home from the mines. <hex:021A020203>He<hex:021A020103> saved me from becoming its dinner. He was strapping and sweet, and so I learned his patrol route. Brought him iguana tails, talked about sediment─you know, the usual stuff.

56.original: Then, once we'd gotten to know each other, I confessed my feelings. But he refused me, saying he could never court a Tholl. Said it was impossible...

57.original: <sniff> I almost wish he'd left me for the cliffkite... But he's probably right. Who in Tomra would recognize our love? Who is there to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> me on?

59.original: ...Thank you. There'll be few enough kind words for me if news gets out. But I won't give up! I'll think of a way for my Gogg and I to be together!

60.original: I see you got my friend to come back, but she was in too much of a hurry to spare me a second glance. What happened out there?

64.original: She fell in <hex:021A020203>love<hex:021A020103> with him!? With a Gogg? Ugh, the chief can never know about this...

65.original: Not your place to say, eh? Well, I was meaning to talk to her about this anyway...

66.original: Thank you for your help, stranger. I'll do my best to keep her out of trouble!
